She rants and vents out loud to the starry sky that she wants to give up and quit being president, just letting off steam. titleNative: 絶対可憐チルドレン
synopsis: In the future, as people with ESP increase in numbers, so does the possible good and evil they can cause to society. The Japanese government establishes of the Base of Backing ESP Laboratory (BABEL), a special esper organization tasked with dealing with situations that can't be resolved by ordinary means, including dealing with espers engaged in criminal activity. Prodigy Kouichi Minamoto is assigned by BABEL to the task of supervising the most powerful espers in the country, a trio of gifted but mischievous young girls known as "The Children". The Children and Minamoto must deal with several enemy organizations, each with conflicted views regarding the role of espers in the world, including "PANDRA", a cadre of rogue espers determined to wage war against the rest of mankind; "Black Phantom", a mercenary organization who brainwashes espers into living tools of destruction; and the "Normal People", composed solely of non-esper individuals who view espers only as a threat to be vanquished. title: Mietemasu yo! Aizawa-san
titleNative: 見えてますよ! 愛沢さん
synopsis: Michi has always been troubled by the fact that she can see ghosts. She pretends not to see, trying not to get involved. However, a ghost has appeared that even she cannot ignore. It is Honami Aizawa, a former member of the popular idol group De:LPhinus. She was also a classmate of Michi, and she haunts the classroom out of unfulfilled longing. Michi is determined not to get involved with ghosts, but she finds herself following Honami's childish and outlandish behavior, unable to look away from her ardent fan-service(?).......
